name: Missing Signer Check
description: Sensitive instruction executed without verifying signer authorization.

name: Missing Owner Check
description: Program fails to verify account ownership before use.

name: Missing Key Check
description: Expected public key is not validated against actual account key.

name: Integer Overflow Underflow
description: Unchecked arithmetic causes overflow or underflow.

name: Cross Program Invocation
description: Unsafe cross-program invocation allows malicious execution paths.

name: Numerical Precision Error
description: Loss of precision due to arithmetic ordering or truncation.

name: Bump Seed Canonicalization
description: Non-canonical PDA bump handling creates validation bypass opportunities.

name: Type Confusion
description: Incorrect account type interpretation due to missing validation.
